title: “The explanation makes sense”: An Empirical Study on LLM Performance in News Classification and its Influence on Judgment in Human-AI Collaborative Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying news articles into political ideology categories (Left, Center, Right) using Large Language Models (LLMs) with various prompt designs, comparing the model predictions against publisher-level ground truth, and evaluating how LLM-generated bias classifications and explanations influence human annotators' judgments and confidence in a collaborative annotation task.
